2608.14021.title: Residual Dominance as a Structural Account of Last-Item Reliance in Causal Self-Attention Recommenders
2608.14021.paper_summary: Transformer-based sequential recommenders with causal self-attention often rely heavily on the most recent interaction at inference time, but how this behavior is structurally expressed in the representation used for prediction remains unclear. We combine prediction-time diagnostics with norm-based analysis of the full attention block. First, we show that SASRec-style models exhibit highly localized last-item reliance. We then find that, although self-attention aggregates contextual information, residual addition sharply shifts the full-block representation toward same-position contributions, which we term residual dominance. To probe this interpretation, we use inference-time residual scaling as a controlled diagnostic intervention. Changing the residual strength induces a monotonic trade-off between structural mixing and last-item reliance, while reducing residual strength recovers a subset of final-position misses for which representations at non-final positions already rank the ground-truth item correctly. Our results provide a structural account linking extreme last-item reliance to residual dominance at inference time. The code is publicly available.
2608.14021.paper_summary_zh: 基於Transformer的序列推薦系統，使用因果自注意力，通常在推理時過度依賴最近的互動，但這種行為在用於預測的表示中是如何結構性表達的仍然不清楚。<lb/>我們將預測時的診斷與基於範數的完整注意力塊分析結合起來。<lb/>首先，我們顯示SASRec風格的模型展現出高度局部化的最後項依賴。<lb/>接著我們發現，儘管自注意力聚合了上下文信息，但殘差加法卻將整個塊的表示急劇偏向同位置的貢獻，我們稱之為殘差主導。<lb/>為了探究這一解釋，我們使用推理時的殘差縮放作為一種受控的診斷干預。<lb/>改變殘差強度會在結構混合和最後項依賴之間產生單調的權衡，而減少殘差強度則恢復了一組最終位置的缺失，對於這些位置，非最終位置的表示已經正確地對真實項進行排名。<lb/>我們的結果提供了一個結構性解釋，將極端的最後項依賴與推理時的殘差主導聯繫起來。<lb/>代碼已公開可用。
